# NavigationArea

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("NavigationArea")`

Marks the walkable ground inside its parent part's box with a `Label`. `NavigationService:SetAreaCost` sets the cost of walking through each label, for water that agents should go around, mud that slows them, or a closed door. The part only defines a volume; it does not need to collide or be anchored. Ground that no area marks has a cost of 1.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Label` | `string` | `"Area"` | read/write | The name the area's cost is set by. Areas with the same label share a cost. |
